Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question:
Question No (1-6) choose the closest meaning of underlined words:
1) The attacking army has closed off all the exits so no one could leave the beleaguered city.
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Beleaguered means surrounded now, destroyed means ruin, haphazard means indiscipline, besieged means surrounded and exhausted means drained of one's physical or mental resources; very tired.. So besieged is the closest.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 2) The football player’s career was ended by a debilitating injury to his knee.
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Debilitating means making someone or something weak. In option cripple means cause severe and disabling damage to; unexpected means regarded as not likely to happen, precipitate cause to happen sudden, instantaneous means occurring or done instantly. So cripple is the closest.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 3) They built their house on an idyllic spot.
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Idyllic means naturally peaceful. Now in option, Rugged means uneven surface. So option A is closest to meaning.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 4) Terrorist commits wanton acts on a helpless populace to make their point.
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Wanton means malicious. Superfluous means unnecessary, Benevolent means kind, sharp means pierce, egregious means outstandingly bad So Egregious is the closest.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 5) The very old man spent his last days ruminating about death and eating box after box of vanilla wafers.
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Ruminate means ponder or think deeply. Frightening means daunting, contemplate means think deeply. So contemplating is the closest.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 6) She exhibited remarkable sangfroid during the crisis.
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Sangfroid means patience. Here, Temper means state of mind; irritation means impatient, composure means the state or feeling of being calm. So Composure is the closest in meaning.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question:
Choose the closest answer for question no 7 to 12
7) ‘A person habitually silent or taking little’ is called-
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Taciturn means reserved, servile means willingness to serve others, unequivocal means leaving no doubt, synoptic means making a summary. So Option A is the best choice.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 8) One who cannot be corrected:
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Incurable means not able to be cured, incorrigible means not able to be corrected, Hardened means having become or been made hard or harder, Invulnerable means not able to defend.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 9) A person not sure of the existence of god:
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Agnostic means a person who believes that nothing is known, Atheist means a person who disbelieves god, Theist means believer. Cynic means a person who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 10) To take secretly in small quantities:
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Defalcation is misappropriation of funds; Pilferage means stealing a little quantity.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 11) One who does not marry, especially as a religious obligation:
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Bachelor means not married but it does not link with religious purpose. Virgin is not related to marriage. Recluse means a person who lives a solitary life and tends to avoid other people. Celibate means abstaining from marriage and sexual relations, typically for religious reasons.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 12) To issue a thunderous verbal attack:
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Languish means grow weak or feeble, animate means lively, fulminate means express vehement protest, Invigorate means give strength or energy to. So fulminate is the answer.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question:
Find the odd one in meaning from the options (questions 13-16)
13) HACKNEYED
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: HACKNEYED, TRITE, STALE have the same meaning so SUCCOR means assistance or hardship. So succor is different from other options.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 14) IMPECCABLE
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: IMPECCABLE, IMMACULATE and IRREPROACHABLE have the same meaning ‘perfect’. IMPETUOUS means acting or done quickly without thought. So Impetuous is the odd one.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 15) FLASHY
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Flashy, Garish and Conspicuous means showy. Pauper means poor. So Pauper is the odd one.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 16) FIDELITY
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: FIDELITY, RECTITUDE and PROBITY mean show honesty. Perfidy means deceitfulness. So perfidy is the answer.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question:
Find the words that is opposite to the meaning (questions 17-23)
17) VANITY
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Vanity means excessive pride. Pride and conceit are similar to Vanity and Ostentatious means showy. Humility means modesty. So Humility is the answer.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 18) HOLLOW
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Hollow means having a hole or empty space inside. Substantial means considerable importance is not related to Hollow. Since solid has no vacant space so solid is the closest answer.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 19) STRINGENT
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Stringent means strict, precise and exacting. Vehement means showing strong feelings, Lenient means merciful. So strict is the opposite of the merciful. Lenient is the answer.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 20) ACQUITTED
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Acquitted means free (someone) from a criminal charge by a verdict of not guilty. Convicted means declared guilty of a criminal offense.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 21) TORTUOUS
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Tortuous means full of twists and turns. Twisting, compound and manifold are similar in meaning. Straight is the answer.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 22) DESICCATED
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Desiccated means dried out. Shriveled, dried and dehydrated are similar in meaning. Fresh is the opposite.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 23) DUCTILE
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Ductile means flexible. Docile, Pliable and supple mean flexible. Stiff means inflexible.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question:
Select the appropriate meaning of the given word (questions 24-30)
24) SPORADIC
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Sporadic means occurring at irregular intervals. Intermittent means not continuous, Insolate means to place in sunlight. Isolate means to be apart from others. So the answer is intermittent.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 25) SHUN
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Shun means persistently avoid, ignore, or reject. Compel means to obligate, Alleviate means to make something less severe. So Avoid is the answer.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 26) RESENT
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Resent means feeling bitterness. Heal means to become healthy, Deceive means cheating, Strike means hit forcibly. So dislike is the answer.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 27) VERNACULAR
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Vernacular means dialect. So slang is the answer.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 28) RECRIMINATION
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Recrimination means accusation in response to one from someone else. So Counteraccusation is the answer. Vilify and defame means speak or write abusively. Laud means praise.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 29) AUGUST
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: August means respected and impressive. So answer is dignified.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: 30) ABUNDANT
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp: Abundant means ample, enough, plenty, copious, profuse etc. So plenty is the answer.
